limitations: All proposals inherit the existing Ti3SiC2-based small-cluster parent motifs; geometry separation does not establish independent morphology or thermal coverage.
Three development-validation geometries are generated from existing parent inputs with interface-specific transverse Ag translations and a 0.15 A local framework displacement.
Three withheld-test distance candidates are regenerated from parent inputs using offsets -0.20 A (AgC), -0.175 A (AgSi) and +0.175 A (AgTi); prior wide-span proposals are design references only.
Three additional withheld-test geometries combine interface-specific lateral Ag translations with a 0.15 A local marked-framework displacement; they are controlled designs, not relaxed structures.
A must accept/freeze the role manifest before V17 training; no labels exist, so DFT labels need a separate owner assignment.
